name: docbook-xsl
description: The DocBook XSL Stylesheets package contains XSL stylesheets. These are useful for performing transformations on XML DocBook files.

package: cp -R VERSION assembly common eclipse epub epub3 extensions fo highlighting html htmlhelp images javahelp lib manpages params profiling roundtrip slides template tests tools webhelp website xhtml xhtml-1_1 xhtml5 $DESTDIR/usr/share/xml/docbook/xsl-stylesheets-nons-1.79.2/

for uri in http://cdn.docbook.org/release/xsl-nons/1.79.2 https://cdn.docbook.org/release/xsl-nons/1.79.2 http://cdn.docbook.org/release/xsl-nons/current https://cdn.docbook.org/release/xsl-nons/current http://docbook.sourceforge.net/release/xsl/current; do
  for rewrite in System URI; do
    xmlcatalog --noout --add "rewrite$rewrite" "$uri" "file://$DESTDIR/usr/share/xml/docbook/xsl-stylesheets-nons-1.79.2" $DESTDIR/etc/xml/catalog
  done
done
